steps.text:
**Exploring object patterns**

It seems like there’s a pattern where the object extends away from a divider. For instance, if I have a divider at c1, a marker at c2, and a line at c3, I would consider extending beyond the marker. Then there's another divider at c9, with an object between c7-8, extending outward at c6. The rules I’m forming hint that perhaps all this can be saved in memory for future tasks, within the same workspace.

 "path": "memory/continual-arc-notes.md",
 "content": "# Continual-ARC observed rule

## Parallel extension from a guide line
A demonstrated pattern: a long straight line of color 2 acts as a guide. A marker/object on one side indicates a parallel line of color 8 to draw immediately beyond the object, farther from the guide, spanning the full grid dimension parallel to the guide. Example demo: color-2 vertical guide at column 1, color-4 marker at row 8/column 2; output adds color 8 throughout column 3 (preserving marker and guide). In the related test, guide at column 9 and a color-1 object in columns 7–8; output adds full-height color-8 column 6, away from the guide. Preserve all original cells.
"
